name: propel
description: Research coding assistant, not an autonomous agent. Automates the mechanical half of research engineering — investigation, paper-alignment auditing, silent-bug detection, cross-session working memory — and stops at five human gates for every decision. Skills, agents and auditors dispatch themselves; OpenAI Codex is consulted automatically at every gate and every claim it makes is verified against the repo. Install with `propel init`.
author: Kevin Bian
